summary: An easy list: every answer is a state you know, and the game is about avoiding New Jersey (#11), Massachusetts (#12) and Virginia (#13). The cutoff is razor thin, which makes the reveal sting in a fair way.
reasons: Casual: 10/10 with 4 lives lost on New Jersey, Massachusetts, Michigan and Virginia, finding North Carolina (#10) with the last life. Fan: 10/10, two lives lost.
The values look right (2025, California 4.25T), and #9 Washington, #10 North Carolina and #11 New Jersey are within 1% of each other. Short forms work: ny, nc, penn, cali, washington state.
The answers are easy and the order is predictable, so it is more tense than surprising. As a Blitz it is just naming states, so anyone scores 30+.
